overview: This paper proposes a normalized classifier-free guidance mechanism for masked discrete diffusion models that decouples jump rates from jump distributions via column normalization of the rate matrix, along with theoretical analysis and empirical validation showing that increasing guidance schedules improve sample quality across image and text generation tasks.

modules.name: CTMC Discrete Diffusion Foundation
modules.description: Implement the continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) backbone for discrete diffusion, including the forward dynamics dp_t/dt = R_t p_t and the time-reversal formulation dp_{T-t}/dt = R_{T-t} p_{T-t}, with the concrete score ratio p_t(y)/p_t(x) enabling backward sampling.

modules.name: Masked Diffusion Rate Matrix Construction
modules.description: Construct the masked diffusion forward rate matrix where tokens transition only from clean states to the masked state with unmasking schedule sigma(t), and compute the corresponding backward rate matrix using the concrete score, including the key identity p_t(x_hat)/p_t(x) = e^{-sigma_bar_t}/(1-e^{-sigma_bar_t}) * p_0(x_hat_i | x_{UM}).

modules.name: Unlocking Guidance Implementation
modules.description: Implement the baseline unlocking guidance of Nisonoff et al., which interpolates rate matrices via R_t^{(w)}(y,x) = R_t(x,y) * (p_t(y)/p_t(x))^w * (q_t(y)/q_t(x))^{1-w}, where the normalizing constant Z_w appears as a multiplicative factor in the overall jump rate, causing unintentionally fast unmasking.

modules.name: Simple Guidance Implementation
modules.description: Implement the baseline simple guidance of Schiff et al., which directly interpolates transition probabilities via p_simple^{(w)}(z_s|z_t) proportional to p^w(z_s|z_t) * q^{1-w}(z_s|z_t), with linear w-dependence in the log-transition as opposed to the exponential w-dependence of unlocking guidance.

modules.name: Normalized Guidance (Proposed Method)
modules.description: Implement the proposed column-normalized guidance mechanism that explicitly decouples jump rate and jump distribution: rate = r_{t,p}^w(x) * r_{t,q}^{1-w}(x) and distribution = Z_w^{-1} * p_t^w(y|x) * q_t^{1-w}(y|x), removing the Z_w factor from the overall rate. In masked diffusion, this reduces to applying softmax to the interpolated logits instead of exp, requiring only a one-line code change.

modules.name: Numerical CTMC Samplers
modules.description: Implement Euler and tau-leaping numerical integration schemes for simulating the guided backward CTMC dynamics, including the transition delta(x) + change * p_theta for Euler stepping and the tau-leaping variant, supporting all three guidance mechanisms (unlocking, simple, normalized).

modules.name: Dynamic Guidance Schedule Framework
modules.description: Implement the framework for time-varying guidance strength w(t), including constant, left interval, right interval, ramp-up, and ramp-down schedules. Support piece-wise constant schedules with arbitrary time partitions and guidance weights per interval.

modules.name: 1D Theoretical Analysis Module
modules.description: Implement exact analytical computation of the sampled distribution under varying guidance schedules for the single-token (d=1) case, including Theorem B.1 (piece-wise constant guidance), Corollary B.1 (constant guidance), and visualization of unmasking rates p_t(M) as a function of time for different Z_w values to demonstrate the fast-unmasking pathology.

modules.name: 2D Theoretical Analysis Module
modules.description: Implement exact analytical computation for the two-token (d=2) case using the structured rate matrix with blocks D_i, C_i, L and Lemma C.1 for matrix exponentiation, computing the sampled distribution under piece-wise constant schedules and Corollary 3.1's coefficient evolution analysis to characterize the interpolation of tilted distributions p^{(w)} and combined distributions p^{(w,gamma)}.

modules.name: Toy Example Visualization
modules.description: Construct the 2D toy dataset with 4 clusters (two intersecting in the middle) and implement visualization of tilted distributions for varying w values, combined distributions p^{(w,gamma)}, and coefficient evolution plots for different t2 values to illustrate theoretical predictions about guidance schedule effects.

modules.name: ImageNet Conditional Generation Evaluation
modules.description: Implement the ImageNet-256 conditional generation pipeline using MaskGIT with guided masked diffusion, computing FID scores over 50K samples across varying guidance strengths and schedules, and generating Precision-Recall curves to assess the fidelity-diversity tradeoff for normalized vs. unlocking vs. simple guidance.

modules.name: Text-to-Image GenEval Benchmark
modules.description: Implement evaluation on the GenEval benchmark using Meissonic and Show-O as base models, measuring prompt alignment across sub-categories (Overall, Single Object, Two Objects, Counting, Colors, Color Attribution, Position) with and without normalization across multiple guidance weights.

modules.name: Text Generation Evaluation (MATH-500)
modules.description: Implement the LLaDA-8B-Instruct evaluation pipeline on MATH-500, using autoregressive-in-blocks sampling (32-token blocks with 32 denoising steps per block) with a simple Euler sampler without remasking to isolate the effect of guidance and normalization on mathematical reasoning performance.

modules.name: QM9 Molecule Generation Evaluation
modules.description: Implement the QM9 small molecule generation pipeline with both uniform and masked diffusion, conditioning on ring count, and evaluating validity, uniqueness, novelty, and ring count alignment across guidance strengths for normalized vs. simple vs. unlocking guidance.

modules.name: Guidance Schedule Ablation Framework
modules.description: Implement systematic comparison of guidance schedules (Left Interval, Right Interval, Ramp-Up, Ramp-Down, Constant, Increasing) on ImageNet-256, sweeping endpoint and schedule parameters to validate theoretical predictions that increasing schedules outperform decreasing ones and that three-interval schedules facilitate easier tuning.

modules.name: Sample Visualization and Quality Analysis
modules.description: Implement side-by-side visual comparison of generated samples across guidance mechanisms and strengths for ImageNet classes, text-to-image prompts, and qualitative assessment of image sharpness and stability as a function of guidance weight, producing comparison grids and error analysis figures.
